> > Fact From Story The report found that Arabic content was flagged as potentially violating at significantly higher rates than Hebrew content was, and was more likely to be erroneously removed.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A less standardized language is more difficult to moderate accurately than a more standardized language.

> > Commonsense Knowledge Implementing policy changes and classifiers for one language does not guarantee equal moderation accuracy across all languages.
> Commonsense Knowledge A less standardized language is more difficult to moderate accurately than a more standardized language.
